problem: How does deformation twinning proceed in BCC nanocrystals and does it depend on size?
mechanism_or_method: In situ atomic-scale TEM straining plus atomistic simulations reveal reluctant twin growth above 15 nm and fast growth below.
limitation: Limited to Ta nanocrystals under in situ TEM conditions; bulk relevance unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides nanostructured BCC metal design for strength-ductility.

problem: How can free-form 3D DNA assemblies with curvature and vertices be designed automatically?
mechanism_or_method: MagicDNA 2.0 GUI design tool informed by coarse-grained molecular dynamics, validated by fabricating DNA origami.
limitation: Validated on a limited set of shapes; structural fidelity checked qualitatively.

problem: Can T-shaped crossover tiles build diverse 2D tessellations and reconfigurable nanorings?
mechanism_or_method: Integrate T junction with antiparallel crossover tiles to give orthogonal binding and rigidity, enabling reconfigurable ladders and rings.
limitation: Demonstrated only in vitro; no functional pore application shown.

problem: How does collective behavior of nonlinear soft flow elements produce history-dependent resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Minimal network of negative-differential-resistance elements forms a fluidic memristor from collective hysteresis loops, shown by experiments, theory, simulation.
limitation: Minimal network only; scaling to large networks and practical fluidic circuits untested.
decision_relevance: Enables tunable resistors and memory in soft fluidic systems.

problem: Can a non-sulfur catalyst produce green diesel from renewable oils without sulfur replenishment?
mechanism_or_method: Frustrated Lewis pairs from P-doping NiAl oxide give stable hydrodeoxygenation with over 90% selectivity for 500 h.
limitation: Tested only up to 500 h at lab scale.

problem: Can phase-interconvertible metal-organic polyhedra yield membranes with enhanced porosity and CO2 selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize polyhedra that interconvert between liquid, glass and crystal phases to process membranes.
limitation: Abstract gives no scale-up or durability data.

problem: How can cell-generated contractions be used to probe the rheology of 3D microtissues?
mechanism_or_method: Light-controlled RhoA activation induces local contractions while microtissue stress and strain are monitored.
limitation: Engineered fibroblast microtissues only; relevance to native tissues unproven.

problem: Can purely dissipative kirigami support propagating kinks usable for machine-like functions?
mechanism_or_method: Rate-dependent texture switching in viscoelastic kirigami produces sequential snapping and diffusive kink propagation.
limitation: Slow kink dynamics and material-specific viscoelasticity limit speed and generality.
decision_relevance: Enables passive sensing and transport in soft mechanical metamaterials.

problem: What is the nature of long-time atomic transport during physical aging of metallic glass?
mechanism_or_method: Coherent x-ray scattering over 300,000 s with atomistic simulations reveals sub-diffusive, intermittent collective motion and power-law relaxation.
limitation: Single glass composition; synchrotron access required.
decision_relevance: Informs long-term stability prediction of metallic glasses.

problem: Can free-standing cg-N be synthesized and stabilized at ambient pressure without toxic precursors?
mechanism_or_method: DFT guided potassium stabilization; plasma-enhanced CVD from potassium azide gives cg-N stable to 760 K.
limitation: Energetic material with decomposition at 760 K; small-scale synthesis only.

problem: Can activity generate knots in polymers for macromolecular topology engineering?
mechanism_or_method: Simulations show anchored active polymers self-knot via giant conformation fluctuations and ratchet knots to the anchor.
limitation: Purely simulated coarse-grained model; no experimental realization.

problem: Is seismic magnitude clustering present across field and laboratory catalogs?
mechanism_or_method: Statistical tests of magnitude clustering across many catalogs from mm to 1000 km, plus modeling of repeating magnitudes.
limitation: Physical mechanism for clustering remains unresolved.
decision_relevance: Could add magnitude clustering to earthquake forecasting models.

problem: Can alkyne-to-alkene conversion drive instant reversible deformation of a 2D carbon film?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric graphdiyne film deforms through acetone-triggered alkyne-to-alkene bond conversion, recovering in air.
limitation: Responds to acetone vapor only; stability outside lab not shown.

problem: How does modulating activity govern phase transitions and active turbulence in phoretic media?
mechanism_or_method: Large-scale agent-resolved simulations map solid-liquid-gas and laminar-turbulent transitions as activity varies.
limitation: Simulation-only; no new experiments confirm the proposed phase landscape.

problem: How can design and evolution be unified as one cyclic process for engineering biology?
mechanism_or_method: Perspective framing traditional design, directed evolution and trial-and-error on an evolutionary design spectrum.
limitation: Conceptual framework without quantitative validation.

problem: How does intramolecular dynamic coupling affect surface relaxation of polymer glasses?
mechanism_or_method: Surfaces with chain loops of varied penetration depth, surface dissipation experiments and Monte Carlo simulations show coupling suppresses surface mobility.
limitation: Specific polymer systems and surface preparation; generality unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides thin-film glass thermal stability tailoring.

problem: How to give consistent quantitative haptic sensation despite varying finger pressure?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent electrotactile screen with pressure-sensitive transistors calibrates stimulation; electric-field interference enables remote stimulation, validated by evoked potentials.
limitation: Small human validation; long-term skin comfort and robustness not addressed.

problem: What causes shape distortion during sintering of uniformly heated parts?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments and a continuum model show nonhomogeneous temperature drives long-range mass transport opposite the temperature gradient.
limitation: Two candidate mechanisms not discriminated; specific materials tested.
decision_relevance: Guides temperature uniformity and distortion control in sintering-based manufacturing.

problem: Do topological defects exist in glasses and govern their plasticity?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary on a study combining topological theory with simulations that identifies defects in disordered solids.
limitation: Commentary only; relies on simulation evidence of another study.

problem: How do history-dependent adsorbate states and metastability drive negative gas adsorption in flexible MOFs?
mechanism_or_method: In situ diffusion studies with XRD, SEM and modeling on two isoreticular MOFs map each sorption step.
limitation: Two MOFs and one adsorbate (n-butane) only.

problem: Can membranes recover steam and latent heat from incinerator flue gas for water and energy?
mechanism_or_method: Layered organosilica membrane tested six months in lab and bench-scale at a running incinerator, with process simulation.
limitation: Bench-scale on-site test only; long-term industrial durability unproven.
decision_relevance: Supports adding membrane steam recovery to waste incinerator plants.

problem: Can elastocapillarity drive programmable nanofluidic switches enclosing zeptoliter liquid volumes?
mechanism_or_method: Layered-material nanochannels collapse and reopen by elastocapillarity; theory predicts reversibility phase diagram guiding capsule design.
limitation: Nanofabricated devices of specific 2D materials; integration into circuits not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides geometry and material choice for switchable nanofluidic elements.

problem: What are the scaling exponents of low-frequency vibrational density of states in disordered solids?
mechanism_or_method: Classify glasses as stable or unstable and find two robust scaling exponents whose competition reconciles the debate.
limitation: Computer glass models; experimental confirmation absent.

problem: How to selectively recover V(V) from complex metal mixtures and tailings?
mechanism_or_method: Acid-stable cyclic imidedioxime ligand forms anionic V(V) complexes separated by pH-controlled precipitation.
limitation: Lab scale; tested on synthetic mixtures and one real tailings type.

problem: Can computer vision automate band-gap and stability characterization to match high-throughput synthesis?
mechanism_or_method: Adaptive computer vision algorithms compute band gaps and stability of 200 compositions in minutes, 85x faster.
limitation: Demonstrated on one perovskite family FA-MA PbI3.

problem: What controls epithelial wrinkling and the wrinkle-to-fold transition under compression?
mechanism_or_method: Epithelium on ECM hydrogel bilayer model with theory shows strain-stiffening and poroelasticity set fold structures.
limitation: In vitro model may not capture in vivo tissue complexity.

problem: What forces did the Tonga eruption exert on the solid Earth and atmosphere coupling?
mechanism_or_method: Teleseismic P and Rayleigh wave analysis determines force time history; atmospheric Lamb wave and standing acoustic waves examined.
limitation: Single event; resolution limited to periods under about 50 s.

problem: Can soft-and-hard colloidal co-assembly give thermoresponsive microactuators?
mechanism_or_method: Valence-limited assembly of anisotropic MOF particles with liquid droplets forms MicroSpine chains that bend via thermoresponsive swelling.
limitation: Microscale lab demonstration; actuation force and cycling durability not quantified.

problem: Can transfer and measurement of superlubric materials be fully automated?
mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning-assisted automated system selects flakes with over 98% accuracy, measures self-retraction force in 30 s, assembles arrays.
limitation: Bespoke micromanipulation hardware; only graphite flakes demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Enables high-throughput screening of superlubric contacts.

problem: How to make azopolymer deformation reversible and controllable by light polarization?
mechanism_or_method: Embed azopolymer microparticles densely in rubbery matrix so polarization sets two reversible degrees of freedom.
limitation: Small creeping losses remain; requires laser beam control.

problem: How to efficiently remove trace CO from hydrogen?
mechanism_or_method: Bead-structured Mg13CuCeOx sorbent; Mg boosts porosity and Cu+ area; mechanism via in situ DRIFTS.
limitation: Only 20 regeneration cycles tested at lab scale.

problem: How does spall damage evolve in time and with microstructure under dynamic loading?
mechanism_or_method: In situ absorption contrast imaging at 1.6 micrometer resolution tracks void nucleation and growth.
limitation: Requires large-facility imaging; limited microstructure conditions.
decision_relevance: Provides data to validate dynamic damage models for impact-resistant materials.

problem: Can origami tessellation mechanics exist at molecular level in a MOF?
mechanism_or_method: Zn-porphyrin 2D MOF with flexible linker pivots, shown by experiments and theory to fold like origami.
limitation: Single MOF; mechanical properties as metamaterial not quantified.

problem: How to restore diffusion-blurred thermal images to optical resolution for subsurface imaging?
mechanism_or_method: eTC-PCT with second-derivative, adaptive filtering and Richardson-Lucy deconvolution using experimental point spread function.
limitation: Tested on few biological samples; depth limits not quantified.

problem: Can woven membranes with on-demand wettability separate oil-water nanoemulsions at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Core-shell fibers with robust core and CO2-responsive shell are tightly woven to give switchable pores.
limitation: Module-scale tests only; real industrial effluents not reported.

problem: How to build muscle-like electrostatic actuators with impact damping?
mechanism_or_method: Elastomer-enhanced auxetic structure with electrostatic zipping gives 59% contraction, 15 N force and rapid shock absorption.
limitation: Needs high voltage; lifetime and efficiency not detailed.
decision_relevance: Supports compliant, shock-tolerant actuators for bionic robots.

problem: How do disordered edges cause friction in microscale superlubric graphite contacts and can it be removed?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-technique edge characterization, full-atom MD, and tensile SixNy caps that lift edges achieve vanishing friction of 0.1 kPa.
limitation: Microscale mesas in lab; scalability to practical devices not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides edge design to realize ultralow-friction superlubric contacts in MEMS.

object: van der Waals adhesion on supported graphene
problem: Is van der Waals interaction in multilayer structures many-body, as predicted?
mechanism_or_method: AFM tip adhesion on supported graphene compared with pairwise versus many-body dispersion theory.
limitation: Graphene on a few substrates only; AFM tip geometry uncertainty.
decision_relevance: Informs adhesion modelling for MEMS and 2D surface assembly.

problem: What causes non-Arrhenius self-diffusion in BCC tungsten?
mechanism_or_method: Ab initio framework with machine-learning potential computes transition-state Gibbs energies including anharmonicity.
limitation: Tested on tungsten and one HCP high-entropy alloy; vacancy mechanism only.
decision_relevance: Enables ab initio diffusion databases for high-temperature material selection.

problem: How can isomer diffusion selectivity within MOF thin film channels be steered and reversed?
mechanism_or_method: Kinetic mass uptake experiments with molecular simulation reveal dynamic adsorbate-MOF interactions used to reverse haloalkane selectivity.
limitation: One MOF film and haloalkane isomers only.

problem: Can a water-selective polymer membrane shift equilibrium and prevent poisoning in catalytic reactors up to 400 C?
mechanism_or_method: Thermally rearranged polybenzoxazole hollow fibers selectively remove water in situ from reactions.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor; long-term membrane durability not detailed.
decision_relevance: Supports integrating water-removal membranes in high-temperature reactors.

object: self-propelled Janus colloids at a wall
problem: How can active colloids climb a vertical wall against gravity?
mechanism_or_method: Adhesive aligning wall enhances polarity heterogeneity; experiments and numerical model show a steady climbing flux.
limitation: Janus colloid model system; harnessing the global work practically untested.

problem: Can objects behind a high-impedance metal barrier be imaged ultrasonically?
mechanism_or_method: Fabry-Perot resonance-tailoring panel placed before barrier customizes resonance frequency to reduce attenuation.
limitation: Underwater lab setup; skull or practical barriers not demonstrated.

object: soft composite solids with stiff microspheres
problem: How does jamming criticality control strain-stiffening of densely filled soft composites?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments on filled elastomers show critical scalings near shear-jamming transition link composite mechanics to matrix and particle elasticity.
limitation: Spherical particles in elastomers only; other inclusion shapes untested.
decision_relevance: Guides filler fraction and matrix choice in soft composite design.

object: exhumed seismic fault with shocked garnet
problem: How is earthquake on-fault energy partitioned among heat, surface energy and lattice distortion?
mechanism_or_method: High-resolution SEM analysis of shocked garnet in exhumed midcrustal fault gives all three energy components.
limitation: Single fault patch and single seismic event.

object: shear bands in thin-film metallic glass
problem: What controls shear band initiation and propagation in metallic glasses?
mechanism_or_method: Pre-structured thin film allows direct strain measurement; continuum model with about 5% elastic limit explains plasticity.
limitation: Thin films with engineered notches; transfer to bulk glasses unproven.
decision_relevance: Informs ductility design of metallic glasses via local strain criterion.

problem: How to create uniform, stress-relaxation-free wrinkles for optical encryption and flexible circuit boards?
mechanism_or_method: Photolithographic light-induced crosslinking defines stress zones, solvent diffusion redistributes stress, thermal polymerization fixes same-material wrinkles.
limitation: Specific polyimide process; long-term reliability not described.

problem: Where in droplets do ice-nucleating proteins trigger freezing?
mechanism_or_method: High-speed cryo-microscopy locates freezing onset in droplets between protein-repellent slides, showing preference for hydrophobic interfaces.
limitation: Droplets between glass slides; atmospheric conditions not replicated.

object: structural superlubric van der Waals contacts
problem: How robust is structural superlubricity under extreme pressures and what causes breakdown?
mechanism_or_method: Graphite and tungsten-tip contacts tested under GPa pressures; atomistic simulations show pressure-assisted bonding triggers wear.
limitation: Microscale contacts of select materials; macroscale applicability unclear.
decision_relevance: Sets pressure limits for superlubric contact design in MEMS.

problem: Can a genuine quantum correction to work fluctuation-dissipation relation be measured?
mechanism_or_method: Laser-induced coherent Hamiltonian rotations and energy measurements on a trapped ion benchmark quantum friction.
limitation: Single-ion system with SPAM errors; not a practical engine.

problem: Can dynamic 3D shape displays hold shape without continuous energy input?
mechanism_or_method: Spatiotemporal jamming of paper interleaved assemblies during substrate relaxation, with buckling-prestrain model for inverse design.
limitation: Prototype-scale tactile display; resolution and refresh speed limited.
decision_relevance: Supports low-energy shape-holding tactile displays for accessibility.

problem: How do chemical disorder and electronic correlations interplay in complex alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Photoemission, resistivity and optical conductivity combined with DFT and dynamical mean-field theory.
limitation: Single archetypal alloy; short-range order only inferred.

problem: Can membranes combine rubbery permeability with framework sieving selectivity for CO2 capture?
mechanism_or_method: Rubbery organic frameworks give CO2/N2 selectivity up to 104 with permeability up to 1000 Barrer, improved by humidity.
limitation: Lab-scale films; aging and real flue gas contaminants not reported.

problem: Can a nematic drop change topology from tactoid to torus?
mechanism_or_method: Interplay of nematic elastic constants favoring splay and bend in tactoids but hindering splay in toroids.
limitation: Specific liquid crystal system; morphogenesis relevance only suggested.

problem: How does ECM remodeling orient stereotyped epithelial folding from stochastic buckling?
mechanism_or_method: Dumpy ECM anchors epithelium to cuticle at specific positions, guiding buckling folds; tested by altered deposition and degradation.
limitation: Drosophila wing only; generality to other tissues unknown.

problem: Can enzymatic glucose and oxygen reactions drive continuous self-sustained actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Glucose oxidase and bilirubin oxidase on opposite film faces create symmetry breaking and ion uptake-release in conducting polymer.
limitation: Lab fuel solution; force output and lifetime not quantified.

problem: How does power flux skewing shape guided waves and resonance patterns in anisotropic plates?
mechanism_or_method: Laser-ultrasonic experiments on single-crystal silicon reveal slow waves and eight zero-group-velocity modes producing beating patterns.
limitation: Single-crystal silicon wafer only; other anisotropic materials untested.

problem: How can adhesion of 2D materials on 3D surfaces be quantified reliably?
mechanism_or_method: Button shear testing with fabricated polymer buttons on graphene, hBN, MoS2, WSe2, with set button dimensions and shear speeds.
limitation: Tested on SiO2 and Si3N4 substrates only; button fabrication needed.
decision_relevance: Guides substrate treatment and annealing for reliable 2D device integration.

problem: Can photochromic surfaces be shielded from chemical degradation via superomniphobicity?
mechanism_or_method: One-pot spray-coated mix of photochromic dye, low surface energy material and polymer gives color change with omniphobic texture.
limitation: Lab coatings; mechanical wear durability not addressed.

problem: Can a nanocavity enrich substrates to boost hydrodeoxygenation of biomass carbonyls?
mechanism_or_method: Etched hollow MIL-101 with sandwiched Ru nanoparticles enriches levulinic acid and H2, giving six-fold activity.
limitation: Single reaction at mild lab conditions; scale-up not shown.
